guides.name: Get yellow underarm stains out of a white shirt
aliases: yellow sweat stains on my white shirt
white shirt turned yellow under the arms
steps: Check the care label to make sure the shirt can be washed.
Rub liquid laundry detergent or dish soap into the yellow spots. Wait 5 minutes.
Mix oxygen bleach into a tub of warm water until it dissolves.
Soak the shirt at least 30 minutes. Leave old, stubborn stains overnight.
Wash it in the hottest water the care label allows.
Check the underarms after washing. If still yellow, soak and wash again.
Hang it to air dry instead of using the dryer.
safety: Use oxygen bleach, not chlorine bleach; chlorine bleach can make the yellow worse.
Do not iron or heat the stained area until the yellow is gone.
Test the soak on a hidden spot first and follow the care label.
stopIf: It is silk, wool, leather, or dry clean only. Take it to a dry cleaner.
The color changes when you test the soak on a hidden spot.
Still yellow after repeating? Antiperspirant residue may be impossible to remove.
